reason: A DSH UI plugin that displays the selected DeepSeek V4 Pro or V4 Flash model's codexradar IQ value and refreshes it from a read-only external API.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 对话框的模型选择区域显示 DeepSeek V4 Pro 或 V4 Flash 的 codexradar IQ 值，并按模型、思考档位和定时周期刷新。
summaries.en: Displays the codexradar IQ value for the selected DeepSeek V4 Pro or V4 Flash model in the DSH composer and refreshes it when the model, reasoning effort, or refresh interval changes.

capabilities: Displays model IQ data in the DSH conversation composer
Requests read-only benchmark data from the codexradar API through a same-origin proxy
Refreshes displayed data on model or reasoning-effort changes and periodically every five minutes
